note: Regional park in the South Saskatchewan River valley 22 km S of Eston on Hwy 30, with a nine-hole grass-greens golf course, licensed clubhouse, outdoor pool (July-August), mini golf and ball diamonds. The full-service sites are back-ins on a row between the clubhouse road and the river woods. Drinking water is sold at the clubhouse and concession. There is no boat launch (the nearest is at the ferry, about 10 km away), but boats can be beached beside the park. --Claude
summary: Keep. Accredited regional park, 48 sites (18 full-service 30 A, 20 x 15 A, 10 non-serviced), all rentable by the night; Let's Camp sells 32 (01-32) with 1-night minimum. Google 4.6 (37). Entry fee rose C$5 -> C$10/day; online booking now opens Jan 1 (was Mar 6). Not waterfront confirmed. Pin within ~180 m of the full-service row; keep.
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: not a seasonal park. The SRPA page: 'All sites can be rented daily, weekly or monthly'; Let's Camp sells 32 of the 48 by the night (min 1 night, max 60). Google 4.6 stars (37 reviews).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The Let's Camp map puts sites 01-18 on the row between Periwinkle Road and Tumbleweed Trail (~50.9631,-108.7668), with Tumbleweed Trail and a wide riparian woodland between them and the South Saskatchewan; on Esri z17 that row is 150-200 m from the river. The power-only row (19-24) is by the maintenance buildings near Hwy 30, farther still.
